subject: Future Tech
title: ITER: The World's Biggest Experiment
description: A quick, practical guide to ITER: The World's Biggest Experiment.

hook.text: 35 nations are building ITER in southern France.

buildup.text: ITER aims to produce 500 MW of fusion power from 50 MW of heating—a tenfold gain. First plasma is expected around 2035.

discovery.text: The reactor will contain plasma at 150 million degrees.

twist.text: ITER is decades late and billions over budget. Critics say private companies will beat it to commercial fusion.

climax.text: Even so, ITER will produce data no other machine can. It's the proving ground for full-scale fusion power plants.

punchline.text: Slow, expensive, essential. That's big science.

quiz.question: How many nations are collaborating on ITER?
